title: Recommendation Feedback Loops Shape Urban Income Segregation and Venue Visitation
summary: A four-city mobility simulation finds that recommender feedback and retraining can increase simulated venue disappearance and income segregation; a reranking intervention reduces both. The results do not establish actual venue closures or observed post-deployment effects.
ai_technology: Learned location recommenders in an iterative mobility and retraining simulation
